conceptual_explanation: The 5** summit of Inversion Mastery involves complex structures like 'Not until', where the inversion happens in the main clause, not the subordinate one. You must also distinguish between 'No sooner... than' and 'Scarcely... when' and handle intricate prepositional triggers like 'Only through' or 'Only once'.

rule_cards.name: The 'Not Until' Shift
rule_cards.correct: Not until he spoke did I realize who he was.
rule_cards.incorrect: Not until did he speak I realized...

rule_cards.name: Scarcely / Barely ... When
rule_cards.formula: Scarcely + had + Subject + PP + when + Past Simple
rule_cards.correct: Scarcely had the game begun when it started to rain.
rule_cards.incorrect: Scarcely had the game begun than it started to rain.

rule_cards.name: Only Once / Only Through
rule_cards.correct: Only through hard work can one achieve greatness.
rule_cards.incorrect: Only through hard work one can achieve...

rule_cards.name: Nor Inversion
rule_cards.correct: He didn't call, nor did he send an email.
rule_cards.incorrect: He didn't call, nor he sent an email.

head_noun_tasks.explanation: 'Not until' triggers inversion in the main clause ('did the fans stop').
'Scarcely' requires past perfect inversion and is paired with 'when'.
'Only through' requires the modal 'can' before the subject 'we'.
'Nor' at the start of a clause triggers inversion of 'can my colleague'.

drill_tasks.question: Not until the sun came out ________ to dry our clothes.
drill_tasks.explanation: 'Not until' requires inversion. 'We were' becomes 'were we'.

drill_tasks.question: Scarcely ________ the speech when the audience erupted in applause.
Only through your help ________ to finish the project on time.
He has no interest in politics, ________.
drill_tasks.explanation: 'Nor' + Aux + Subject is the correct formal structure here.

drill_tasks.question: Barely had she entered the room ________ the lights went out.

boss_fight.paragraph: Not until I reached home I did realize I'd lost my wallet. Scarcely had I entered the room than the phone rang. I don't like coffee, nor my sister does.

errors.original: Not until I reached home I did realize
errors.correction: Not until I reached home did I realize
errors.explanation: 'Not until' requires inversion in the main clause, not the subordinate one.

errors.original: Scarcely had I entered the room than
errors.correction: Scarcely had I entered the room when

success_feedback: Phenomenal! You have mastered the most intricate inversion patterns in English. Your 5** precision is undeniable.
suggested_next_steps: Write a formal letter using at least three different inversion types.
Practice using inversion in the introduction of your DSE Paper 2 essays.
Challenge yourself with archaic or poetic inversion in classic literature.
